provenance.sequence_source: FPbase 'Superfolder GFP' (fpbase.org/protein/superfolder-gfp; Pédelacq et al. 2006), identical over 238 aa. Deposited exactly as protein AGT98536.1 (KF410616, sfGFP(Sp); Overkamp et al. 2013), the oldest standalone deposit in its NCBI identical-protein group, and as the first 238 aa of ASL68970.1, the GenBank record FPbase links (249 aa with a C-terminal tag). Until 2026-11 the part read Q80 and K206 (the monomerizing V206K), a combination no deposit carries; it now matches FPbase. No UniProt entry holds sfGFP.
